raw/ClickHouse - company-research.md.title: ClickHouse Database Company Profile
raw/ClickHouse - company-research.md.summary: ClickHouse is a leading open-source, column-oriented OLAP database used for real-time analytics at petabyte scale. It is expanding its focus into the AI space, offering a commercial cloud service alongside its open-source core. The company recently secured Series D funding and has a strong customer base including Meta and Anthropic.

key_points.point: It is an open-source, column-oriented OLAP database for real-time analytics.
Its business model combines an open-source core with a commercial ClickHouse Cloud using usage/consumption-based pricing.
The company raised $400M in Series D funding at a ~$15B valuation.
Core products include ClickHouse (OSS), ClickHouse Cloud, ClickStack (observability), and ClickPipes.
Its moat includes extreme query speed, open-source adoption, and cost-efficiency versus warehouses.
Strategic focus is becoming the default database layer for AI/agentic apps and observability.

raw/David AI - company-research.md.title: David AI
raw/David AI - company-research.md.summary: David AI operates as an audio data research lab, building the necessary data layer for frontier AI teams working on speech, voice agents, and translation. The company focuses on scaling a data factory process rather than simply selling datasets, starting from a model capability hypothesis. Its business model is B2B audio data infrastructure, serving major AI labs and large enterprises.

key_points.point: Positions itself as the first audio data research lab, building the data layer for frontier AI.
The process involves starting with a model capability hypothesis, designing data shape, and productionizing datasets.
Offers high-quality audio datasets for speech recognition, translation, and conversational AI.
Key products include Converse (two-speaker conversations) and Atlas (multilingual audio dataset).
The company's moat includes audio-native specialization and a research-driven workflow.
The company is scaling its data production engine and contributor supply engine.
Operations builds and scales data pipelines, contributor supply, and quality control.
Product Ops owns data products from prototype to scale and translates operational needs into tooling.
Data / Marketplace Ops focuses on building contributor networks and improving retention.
GTM Engineering involves using funnel analytics and A/B testing for supply-side acquisition.

raw/Decagon - company-research.md.summary: Decagon is positioning itself as an enterprise AI concierge platform, moving beyond simple chatbot vendor status to focus on measurable customer and business outcomes. key_points.point: Decagon builds enterprise AI agents for customer experience across voice, chat, email, and SMS.
The business model is Enterprise SaaS, likely combining subscription, deployment, and usage-based pricing.
The product architecture is a full lifecycle platform: build, deploy, optimize, and scale.
Duet Autopilot enables self-improving agents by turning production signals into proposed, validated updates.
The company emphasizes AOPs (Agent Operating Procedures) to make agent behavior inspectable and editable.
Decagon is focused on scaling from high-touch wins to a repeatable, globally deployable platform.
Key customer proof points include Duolingo's 80% deflection and ClassPass's 95% cost reduction.
The company is hiring heavily in Deployment Strategists to manage complex enterprise deployments.
